title: Kit Green and Garry Nolan study biological effects on UFO witnesses

tellings.quote: electromagnetic radiation damage, which if you like, you know, Kit Green and Gary Nolan, you know, CIA spooky stuff. They're looking at biological effects of people who've witnessed or encountered UFOs.

plain: Kit Green, a medical scientist who worked with the CIA, and Garry Nolan, a Stanford biologist, have studied the bodily effects on people who saw or met UFOs, including what looks like electromagnetic radiation damage. Michels mentions it himself in passing, calling it "CIA spooky stuff," without naming a study, as a sign that these encounters might leave physical traces.
